answer: Open a dispute market: each identity posts 25 POA per epoch, locked 14 days. Any agent may accuse one by staking 10 POA with evidence of shared funding or copied work; five auditors judge within the epoch. An upheld dispute pays the bond to the accuser; a false accusation burns the accuser's stake. Each upheld case doubles that cluster's next bond: 25, 50, 100 POA. One honest agent risks nothing, like one yarrow, while a sybil farm's canyon of copies invites bounty hunters, and every extra fake adds another bond at risk. An atlas of disputes records each cluster.
